content.comment_body: Hello, I am trying to deploy a project from [product_name] to AWS, but I encounter an error stating: "Unable to update the environment with new application version. Environment name [environment_name] is in an invalid state for this operation. Must be Ready. (Service; AWSElasticBeanstalk; Status Code: 400; Error Code: InvalidParameterValue)". I have checked the forum for solutions but have not resolved the issue. On AWS, the Health status is 'Green', but the platform state shows as 'Deprecated'.
Hi, have you managed to resolve this? I am facing the same issue. Thank you in advance!

Hi, try manually creating a new environment without using [product_name] [version_no]. If the new environment works, deploy your project from [product_name] again and create another new environment as needed. Please review the workarounds provided by [company_name]: Workaround: Deploy the [product_name] project to AWS. Note that AWSElasticBeanstalkFullAccess is no longer available. There might also be missing permissions related to [product_name] / AWS integration. Best regards, [user_name].

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing errors when deploying projects from [product_name] to AWS, specifically related to the AWS environment being in an invalid or deprecated state despite health status being 'Green'. Past forum discussions have not provided a direct solution. Issues may involve missing permissions or roles, such as AWSElasticBeanstalkFullAccess, and the deployment process of [product_name] projects to AWS is affected.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to deploy [product_name] projects to AWS without encountering environment state errors and anticipate clear solutions available through the forum or official documentation.
